{{Top|leg|canon=Neimoidian heavy troop}}
[[File:NeimoidianBrute-ROTSGG.png|thumb|right|250px|Neimoidian brute guards were produced via the brute program.]]
The '''brute program''' was a [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] program. The most unpredictable and barbarous members of the [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion]] were enrolled in the program, often against their will, undergoing extreme genetic enhancements. The resulting [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] brute guards were physically larger, more furious, and unstable combatants. Prone to berserker-like outbursts and incidents of violence towards other guards, they were often kept in [[Suspended animation/Legends|stasis]] and only used in dire situations.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
